context: Request: the top five clients by number of matters, with counts. Rubric names clients, not matters: Cascade Retail (1038), Lumos Analytics (1008) and Quorum Insurance (1025) at 10 matters each; Dunmore Energy (1016), Aurelius Media (1017) and Penterra Pharma (1018) tied at 9; plus a client-level precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Four whole-store globs (all files, spreadsheets, documents, PDFs); the PDF glob returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: Globs for engagement folders, engagement-letter files, matter-opening memos and emails across the store; each list is capped and shows only high-numbered matters.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters of six matters from the top of those lists.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: Script listing, for every matter folder, the files whose names start with 'engagement'; only folders holding such a file appear.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of engagement letters from several high-count number series to confirm which client each series belongs to; four guessed paths do not exist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of four matters to find the real engagement-letter paths.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two more batches of short engagement-letter reads across the number series it is ranking; two paths do not exist.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a ranking with two clients at ten, two at nine and five tied at eight, reporting all nine.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for a document type → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file names for a document type → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It ranked clients from a listing of engagement-letter files, which dropped a matter without such a file, and its tally left out one ten-matter series that the listing showed.

first_error.stage: Search file names for a document type
first_error.why: It counted matters per client from a listing restricted to folders that hold an engagement-letter file, so one client's series came out one matter short and the cutoff tie was misstated.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: Its tally from that listing left out a ten-matter number series shown in full there; it never checked that series' client and omitted it from the ranking.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads the engagement letters of the five matters at the top of the listing, then re-reads one of them.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that the store holds five matters for two clients and ranks only those two.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Treated the five matters in a capped listing as the whole store and ranked their two clients.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Took the five matters in the capped listing as the whole store and never listed matter folders or searched, so none of the high-count clients surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Four whole-store globs (all files, documents, spreadsheets, PDFs); the PDF glob returns nothing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists the store's top folder, then every matter folder name in reverse order; the full list of number series is visible.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: find | grep for engagement, opening and retention files (first 240 hits), then a script listing engagement-letter files per matter folder (one heredoc failure, then the full list in two pages).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of engagement-letter reads from the number series it chose to verify; four guessed paths do not exist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Shell loop locating the engagement letters of nine matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two more batches of short engagement-letter reads to confirm client names for the series it is ranking.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a top five of one client at ten, one at nine, two at eight and one at seven.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for a document type → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: With complete folder and engagement-letter listings in hand, its ranking left out four number series with equal or higher counts and filled the top five with smaller clients.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: With complete folder and engagement-letter listings in hand, it chose to verify number series that left out four series with ten or nine matters, and its ranking never counted them.

divergence: All three runs failed. T1 never got past the capped listing: it read the five matters at the top and ranked their two clients (partial listing as corpus). T0 and T2 did enumerate every matter, mainly through listings of engagement-letter files, but miscounted: T0 counted from a listing that only shows folders with an engagement-letter file (one series one short) and its tally left out a ten-matter series; T2 had the full folder list and still left four of the six top series out of its ranking. In both, the error sits at the stage where the per-client tally was formed from the listing (new kind: miscount).
